title: Add Built-in JSON Schema Request Validation Middleware
description: Introduces a zero‑dependency middleware that validates incoming request bodies against JSON Schemas. It automatically returns a 400 response with detailed error messages for invalid payloads, improving security and developer productivity without external packages.
testCases: Valid request body matching the schema proceeds to the next handler and the sanitized data is attached to ctx.validatedBody
Invalid request body returns a 400 response with a JSON error payload describing the schema violations
Missing or malformed schema configuration throws a clear runtime error during app initialization
acceptance: The middleware must accept a JSON Schema object, validate ctx.request.body, attach the cleaned data to ctx.validatedBody, and on failure respond with status 400 and a JSON error list. It should be composable with existing routing and middleware, and must not introduce any external dependencies. All new tests pass and existing test suite remains green.
reason: Ensures data integrity at the edge of the application, reduces boilerplate validation code, and mitigates injection attacks, aligning with Yantraverse's goal of providing a secure, production‑ready framework out‑of‑the‑box.
